newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products start week steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products start week steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer at midday Monday, traders said.
Gasoline was steady in a quiet market. A Eurograde barge traded at $197.50. Traders attributed the cheap price to the fact it had to be loaded by May 20.
Naphtha was talked at higher levels in line with stronger crude futures, but the market was quiet.
Spot gas oil prices were generally firmer, although weaker heating oil barge premiums ahead of the expiry of May IPE futures wiped out most of the futures-led gains.
High sulphur fuel barges held last week's gains to trade at $86 and $87 fob a tonne in quiet trade. Cargo markets were quiet, with higher crude helping prices hold steady.
